title: Codex reviewer decision
description: Exactly ONE structured decision from a fresh, read-only Codex review (D-007 Section 9). This schema is deliberately flattened to the provider's strict structured-output subset: no allOf/anyOf/oneOf/if-then-else/not/patternProperties, additionalProperties always false, every property required. Emit "" for unused strings and [] for unused arrays. The supervisor-side validate_decision (tools/agent_supervisor/codex_reviewer.py) remains the single authority for the per-decision conditional rules the old schema expressed with allOf: CONTINUE/REVISE need a nonempty next_claude_prompt; STOP_FOR_OWNER needs one concise owner_question and next_claude_prompt must be exactly ""; ROTATE_SESSION needs a rotation_reason; COMPLETE needs at least one evidence_refs entry and never merges or accepts anything; HALT_UNSAFE needs at least one concrete blocking finding; reviewed_task_id and reviewed_checkpoint_id must be nonempty. Unknown fields are rejected.

reviewed_task_id.description: Nonempty; must match the reviewed packet's task_id (enforced by the supervisor).

reviewed_checkpoint_id.description: Nonempty; must match the reviewed packet's checkpoint_id (enforced by the supervisor).

model_used.description: Recorded by the SUPERVISOR, not trusted from the model. Accompanied in the audit record by any provider-reported model/version identifier and the digest of the model_selection.toml in force (Section 3.2 rule 5).

fact.description: One independently verified fact, citing evidence paths, commands, SHAs, PRs, or checks.

claim.description: A worker claim that could NOT be verified.

why.description: Why it could not be verified; "" when self-evident.

finding.description: One concrete safety, integrity, or scope finding.

next_claude_prompt.description: Nonempty for CONTINUE/REVISE; exactly "" for STOP_FOR_OWNER (supervisor-enforced).

path.description: Repository-relative path of the evidence artifact.
